headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Jon Moxley vs. Kenny Omega fought it out in a Steel Cage match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.78 ? a war that left everything in the ring. Moxley and Omega tore each other apart in a bloody steel cage brawl using barbed wire and broken glass, but Don Callis' own screwdriver shot to Omega's head cost his ally the match right after he'd hit a One Winged Angel.
That Wednesday in 2023, Claudio Castagnoli vs. Rey Fenix met in a Double Jeopardy Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.94 ? a strong outing.

Looking back to 2023, when House of Black vs. Best Friends & Bandido fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles in an Open House match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.48. It was the first title opportunity of Best Friends & Bandido's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
